questions.question: Swift nima uchun yaratilgan?
options: Apple platformalari — iOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS uchun

questions.question: Swift da o'zgaruvchi qanday e'lon qilinadi?
Swift da let va var farqi nima?
Swift da Optional nima?
options: Qiymat bo'lishi (?T) yoki yo'q bo'lishi (nil) mumkin — null safety

questions.question: Swift da optional unwrapping qanday amalga oshiriladi?
options: if let, guard let, ??, ! forced unwrap — bir nechta usul

questions.question: Swift da struct va class farqi?
options: struct — value type (copy), class — reference type; struct meros olmaydi

questions.question: Swift da guard let nima uchun?
options: Early exit — shart bajarilmasa scope dan chiqish, ko'p nesting dan qochish

questions.question: Swift da enum nima?
options: Ko'p xususiyatli variantlar tipi — associated values, raw values

questions.question: Swift da closure nima?
options: Muhit o'zgaruvchilarini yutadigan anonim funksiya bloki — { params in body }

questions.question: Swift da Array da append() nima qiladi?
Swift da Codable nima?
options: Encodable va Decodable — JSON bilan encode/decode avtomatik

questions.question: Swift da generics nima?
options: Tip parametrlari bilan qayta ishlatiladigan funksiya/tip — func swap<T>(_ a: inout T, _ b: inout T)

questions.question: Swift da extension nima?
options: Mavjud tipga yangi funksionallik qo'shish — retroactive modeling

questions.question: Swift da ARC (Automatic Reference Counting) nima?
options: Xotira boshqarish — reference soni 0 ga tushganda ob'ekt o'chiriladi

questions.question: Swift da weak va unowned reference farqi?
options: weak — optional, nil bo'lishi mumkin; unowned — non-optional, ob'ekt mavjud deb taxmin

questions.question: Swift da computed property nima?
options: Saqlanmagan, har kirishda hisoblanadigan xususiyat — get va set bloki bilan

questions.question: Swift da didSet va willSet nima uchun?
options: Property o'zgarishidan oldin/keyin chaqiriladigan observer — side effect uchun

questions.question: Swift da associated types nima?
options: Protocol da placeholder tip — conform qiluvchi tip konkret tipni belgilaydi

questions.question: Swift da @discardableResult nima uchun?
options: Funksiya qaytarish qiymati ishlatilmasa ham warning bermasligi uchun

questions.question: Swift da mutating nima uchun?
options: struct/enum metodida self ni o'zgartirish — mutating func

questions.question: Swift da defer nima uchun?
options: Scope tugashida bajarilishi kerak bo'lgan kod — cleanup uchun

questions.question: Swift da Result<Success, Failure> nima?
options: success(T) yoki failure(Error) — xato boshqarish uchun

questions.question: Swift da @escaping closure nima?
options: Funksiya qaytgandan keyin ham ishlatilishi mumkin bo'lgan closure — async uchun

questions.question: Swift da any va some farqi (Swift 5.7)?
options: any — existential (runtime dispatch); some — opaque type (compile-time konkret tip)

questions.question: Swift da lazy var nima uchun?
options: Birinchi kirishda initsializatsiya — dastlabki yuklanishni kamaytiradi

questions.question: Swift da map, filter, reduce nima?
Swift da switch da pattern matching nima?
options: Qiymat, range, tuple, enum associated value tekshirish — kuchli switch

questions.question: Swift da inout parametr nima?
options: Funksiyada parametrni pass-by-reference — funksiya tashqarisiga ta'sir qiladi

questions.question: Swift da @propertyWrapper nima?
options: Custom property semantik — @State, @Binding, @Published kabi SwiftUI da ishlatiladi

questions.question: Swift da async/await nima (Swift 5.5)?
options: Structured concurrency — asinxron kodni sinxron ko'rinishda yozish

questions.question: Swift da actor nima?
options: Thread-safe reference type — bir vaqtda faqat bitta task kirishi mumkin

questions.question: Swift da @MainActor nima?
options: Main thread da ishlashni kafolatlash — UI kodi uchun

questions.question: Swift da Sendable protocol nima uchun?
options: Concurrency da xavfsiz uzatiladigan tip — data race oldini olish

questions.question: Swift da existential container nima?
options: any Type ishlatilganda runtime da tip va qiymat metama'lumot bilan saqlanishi

questions.question: Swift da primary associated types (Swift 5.7) nima?
options: some Collection<Int> kabi existential da associated type belgilash

questions.question: Swift da @resultBuilder nima?
options: DSL yaratish uchun — SwiftUI ViewBuilder, funksional sintaksis konstruksiya

questions.question: Swift da opaque return type (some Protocol) nima?
options: Funksiya qaytarish tipi konkret lekin tashqariga yashirilgan — protocol tip sifatida

questions.question: Swift da @_specialize nima?
options: Generic funksiyaning ma'lum tip uchun ixtisoslashtirilgan versiyasini yaratish — performance

questions.question: Swift da COW (Copy-on-Write) nima?
options: Value type lar ko'p egalik bo'lsa xotira ulashadi, o'zgarishda nusxa yaratadi — Array, String

questions.question: Swift da Witness table nima?
options: Protocol conformance uchun dispatch jadvali — existential dispatch

questions.question: Swift da whole module optimization nima?
options: Butun modul kodi birgalikda kompilyatsiya qilinadi — cross-function inline, better optimize

questions.question: Swift da Task nima?
options: Structured concurrency birlik — async kontekstda parallel ish bajarish

questions.question: Swift da continuations nima?
options: Callback asosidagi kodni async/await ga moslashtirish — withCheckedContinuation

questions.question: Swift da memory layout nima?
options: Tip bayt o'lchami, hizalanishi, stride — MemoryLayout<T>.size/alignment/stride

questions.question: Swift da Observation framework (Swift 5.9) nima?
options: @Observable macro — KVO alternativa, minimal, Swift native reaktivlik
